name: Truchet Tiles
desc: A dense field of Smith-truchet quarter-arc tiles weaving continuous maze paths, individual tiles spinning ninety degrees on the beat while travelling glow-fronts trace the connected flow.

density.doc: tile count — higher packs finer tiles (rebuilds field)

energy.doc: fraction of tiles spinning + flow-glow brightness

flow.doc: strength + count of connected-path glow fronts

style.doc: aesthetic — monoline maze / two-ink ribbon / additive neon tubes / white schematic on blue

act.doc: dramaturgy — steady weave / beat-massed flips / slow rotating flow
